headline: Court Permanently Blocks Alabama Admitting Privileges Law
snippet: Judge Thompson permanently struck down as unconstitutional.

headline: Alabama Admitting Privileges Law Blocked Until Next Year
snippet: Federal court temporarily blocked as it would have forced 3 of 5 abortion clinics to close.

headline: Bentley Signs Women's Health and Safety Act
snippet: Required abortion clinic physicians to have local hospital admitting privileges and clinics to meet ambulatory surgical center standards.

headline: Critics say regulations intended to drive abortion clinics out of existence
snippet: Critics argued HB57 was designed to regulate clinics out of existence, not protect health.
